summary: Magnachip Semiconductor Corporation filed an 8-K announcing an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley Securities, Inc. to sell up to $50 million of common stock from time to time under an effective shelf registration statement. The proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes including AI data center and robotics investments. There are no fixed terms, premium, or board recommendation; it is a routine at-the-market equity distribution program. This is an ordinary shelf takedown mechanism, not a transformative special situation.
